text:
The night imaginada

is porosa and with bocas

of Colt and parpadeos

of eyes tácitos. Has

his casas recogidas in madera

of desierto with perro. And there is crujidos

of arboleda  and serpiente

in a acecho black.

¿Is verdad? ¿The cuchillo,

the bala, the puño sordo,

the grito of muchacha violada

that expira, the paseante hecho despojo

and ahorcado  with his   cinto,

the millones of hands, of pupilas,

of pasos redoblantes, of centellas

with blood, son of the  sueño?

Was day    luciente

and a tumor cerebral atado to a rifle

subió  ala torre and explotó dejando

media milla of muertos.

The motor that makes pausa and roba to the child

necesita the light. Voy caminando

for esa esponja of the terror unido

to the “¡What more gives!” that traigo

from lejos, incrédulo.

Not veo more that brazos

of árbol amigo and light in lejanía,

and solo escucho the respiraciones

sosegadas llegando for a aire

of perfume and caricia

that sostiene the pálidas estrellas.

translation.title: The miedo americano
